out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed three handsinks being used improperly. Two handsinks showed signs of being used as a dump sink and equipment cleaning area with a steel scouring pad in them. Another handsink had a large metal food container stored in it.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The PIC corrected all of these issues during the inspection. Do not store items in handsinks or use them as dump stations. They are only to be used for handwashing.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw fish was stored over avocados and other produce in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC moved the raw fish during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: a container of diced tofu was 44º in the wait station refrigerator since yesterday.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC discarded the tofu during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Bottles of Windex were stored next to food and food equipment in the kitchen. Observed bottles of cleaning chemicals and bleach were stored on the three compartment sink drain boards, where clean equipment is meant to be stored.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC corrected this by moving the food and food equipment during the inspection. The PIC moved the cleaning chemicals from the three compartment sink drain boards during the inspection. SUSHI OHAYO (Inspection Date: 08/25/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Several spray bottles of blue liquid (cleaning solution) were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The PIC labeled the spray bottles during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed food stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: a chef’s knife was stored in the gap between a prep refrigerator and the table next to it. Also, spoons were being used to dispense wasabi and ginger from containers in the wait station area and the spoon handles were left in the food, making it difficult to avoid touching the food to get the handles out.
violations.corrective_action: Discontinue storing the knife or any other equipment in between equipment. Those areas are not clean and not a suitable place to store utensils and equipment. The PIC moved the knife during the inspection and had it cleaned and sanitized. The PIC corrected the spoon handles and wait staff use gloves when dispensing foods at this location.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean plates were stored directly next to the handsink on the sushi bar area.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored where they are exposed to splash. The handsink is considered a “unclean” area. Clean equipment and utensils should not be stored next to a dirty area. The PIC moved the plates during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse container was uncovered. The dumpster lids were left open.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. Keep the dumpster lids and doors closed. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed a foul odor near the three compartment sink drain. The odor does not appear to be coming from the grease trap, but it is nearby.
violations.corrective_action: The odor issue has existed during the last inspection too. Please investigate the three compartment sink floor drain. It may need to be snaked by a plumber. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink on the right side of cook line was being used to store equipment in and not being used as a handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Two handsinks did not have hand soap available.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. The handsinks at the sushi prep area and in the wait station area did not have paper towels.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: commercial miso paste was removed from the manufacturer container portioned out in plastic wrap, and held for more than 24 hours, but not date-marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. The PIC date-marked the miso paste portions during the inspection to correct. CDI. SUSHI OHOAYO (Inspection Date: 03/02/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Chemicals (acetone and windex) were stored with clean equipment (new squeeze bottles) and food (salt) on the bottom storage shelves at the expo station.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: the center sushi display case was missing a thermometer.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Replace the missing thermometer as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: several squeeze bottles containing sauces were not labeled. Ingredients at the wok station were not lableled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed large bags of carrots and onions stored on the floor in the walk-in. Observed vinegar for sushi stored on the floor in the kitchen. Observed 5-gallon soy sauce buckets stored on the walk-in floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed at least two wet wiping cloths on the counters at the sushi prep station.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: a knife was stored in a gap between the refrigerator and a prep table, which is an unclean area. Bowls were being used to scoop rice, flour, and other ingredients from large bins.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The PIC moved the knife during the inspection to correct. The PIC removed the bowls. CDI.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed clean cutting boards stored on the floor at the sushi prep station.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. The PIC corrected. CDI. SUSHI OHOAYO (Inspection Date: 03/02/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers (seaweed containers) were observed reused for the storage of food prepared in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: a cardboard box was being used to store portioned miso paste in one of the prep units.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Remove the cardboard box and replace with an appropriate food container. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the outside and handles of the three door freezer in the kitchen were visibly soiled.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean the surfaces as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse container was uncovered. The lid and the doors to both dumpsters were left open.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the grease trap was in need cleaning as evidenced by a foul odor near the warewashing area. Observed grease and food debris on the walls and floor behind the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Please have the grease trap and other areas cleaned as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served or sold in a ready-to-eat form without freezing for parasite destruction is not properly identified as such: observed smoke salmon without appropriate parasite destruction letter or documentation to indicate smoked salmon is ready to eat.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form and the fish is raised and fed as specified by Law, a written agreement or statement from the supplier or aquaculturist stipulating that the fish were raised and fed shall be obtained by the person in charge and retained in the records for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. Please obtain parasite destruction letter from supplier or documentation to support that smoked salmon is ready to eat and provide to EHS within 10 days.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw roe and raw salmon over ready to eat cucumber and shrimp in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC reorganized walk in cooler to store raw items below ready to eat foods.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: observed no disclosure statement on menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Please provide a copy of updated menu to EHS within 10 days.

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: sushi items under ‘Sushi Lover’ section on to go menu.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. Please update all menus to properly indicate the items that are served raw or undercooked and submit to EHS within 10 days.

violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed raw tuna, raw tilapia, and ready to eat shrimp thawing in reduced oxygen packaging (ROP) in walk in cooler.

PIC discarded thawed fish thawing in ROP >4 hours and punctured ROP to eat shrimp observed thawing for 2 hours.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions

violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. Please obtain or create an area for employees to store their personal belongings.
